description: Represents an arc on a unit sphere in spherical coordinates.  This arc is formed by a spherical reference point and then projected from that start point along the unit circle for the length of the arc in radians.

azimuth.description: Azimuthal angle in radians (0 to 2*pi).  Represents the longitudinal position around the sphere.

radiusAngle.description: Angular radius of the small circle in radians.  Represents the angular distance from the center point.

arcLength.description: The arc lenght in radians (-2*pi to 2*pi.
